texts: bad: the query rebuilds the whole reported claim as one sealed block and puts the lanterns in the dimming's 'moved, unchanged' slot, but dimming changes the lanterns, so a faithfully parsed statement files them in the change-of-state slot instead and this question binds nothing. On top of that, a sealed two-event complement (a hard winter forcing, the village dimming) is matched as a single structural term whose conjunct order nothing fixes, so even a slot-correct version of this question can fail to line up with the statement. Keep the reported claim to one finite clause so the sealed content is small and stable: "Why did Brindle Coombe say at the Council that the village would have to dim some lanterns in a hard winter?"
